2.23.42
Tablix.ZIndex
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.ZIndex element specifies the ZIndex of a Tablix. This element is optional and MUST NOT
be specified more than once. If this element is specified, its value MUST be an UnsignedInt.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.ZIndex element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.ZIndex element.
 <xsd:element name="ZIndex" type="xsd:unsignedInt" minOccurs="0" />
